strengths: The large soft head, unequal paddles, compact body, marked wing family and attached stub feet remain the same character in every inspected hand sample. Neither the new offering wrist orientation nor the lowered free hands require inflated mittens or longer arms.

At 160/240px the sharing hand is a clearer outward, upward-cupped shape than the prior little thumb-like side mark. The torso-to-hand relationship reads more deliberately while the opposite quiet mitten remains a stable reference. The supplied sequence samples show a contained outward turn followed by a hold, without a new silhouette family.

Thinking retains the high chin-related action while the free mitten sits lower; Focused has a quieter pair of low hands. Grateful's two lower lobes separate more clearly from the ruff at the larger inspected sizes while remaining a joined gesture. These are useful contour refinements rather than extra detail.

The phone investigation now biases eyes upward and reduces the former lateral head roll while the question sits above. The 790/1190/1900ms contextual samples are more coherent with that placement; the 2350/2720ms samples return to the established viewer-facing head and offer. The 320px night sample and 1440px day sample support a consistent identity across two different compositions.

The source makes the adaptation a bounded, composition-based adjustment of five attention channels, independent of paint. The browser record gives matched day/night values at the inspected times. Actual rendered pairs separately preserve the same face-first identity; numeric equality alone is not used as proof of perceptual equivalence.

The static exported identity remains unchanged and retains the previously accepted hierarchy and crop. The new work therefore strengthens the character-in-content application without weakening the established avatar and header family.

improvementCriteria: Maintain the exact character geometry and shared light/dark numeric posing. Improve application scale, staging or a bounded wrist/head pose before considering any anatomical change.

For a higher whole-identity craft score, demonstrate a further meaningful native-size gain in 96/128px gesture grouping or explicitly constrain which small applications carry expressive claims. Keep intentional chin/clasp contact rather than forcing empty gaps everywhere.

For the unchanged night48 issue, compare masked native-size paint or placement alternatives on intended surrounds; a larger supported night minimum is a valid system decision. Do not add a conspicuous halo to satisfy a nominal size.

Review the outward wrist turn and composition-aware return in continuous normal-speed playback before judging their felt timing. That is an evidence requirement for motion claims, not a currently observed flick defect.
Use unprimed people only when claiming that the gesture means invitation or the moth reliably means Nag. Record their actual viewport/scroll exposure separately from the craft score.
